key_path: Agent installs CLI + skills (`claude plugin install algolia-cli@algolia-skills` or `brew install algolia/algolia-cli/algolia`)
`algolia auth signup` opens browser sign-up page (email/Google/GitHub) - human completes form + email verification
Same command completes OAuth; CLI fetches applications and stores Admin API key in OS keychain (no copy-paste)
`algolia application create --name ... --region ...` if none exists (free Build plan auto-created on signup)
First call: `algolia indices list` / import records
human_gates: dashboard toggle to enable Productivity MCP

agent_native_auth.cli_browser_or_device_login: yes - `algolia auth login` / `algolia auth signup` browser OAuth, `--no-browser` prints URL for SSH/containers; keys stored in keychain
agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: yes - Productivity MCP advertises RFC 9728 metadata; authorization server dashboard.algolia.com exposes registration_endpoint https://dashboard.algolia.com/2/oauth/register (client ID/secret left empty in Claude/ChatGPT)
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: yes - /1/keys creates scoped API keys; secured API keys derivable client-side; CLI `application create`
agent_native_auth.scoped_keys: yes - ACLs, index restrictions, rate limits, referers, secured keys
agent_native_auth.test_credentials_sandbox: partial - public demo app credentials (e.g. in llms.txt for site search); no sandbox mode

mcp.product_mcp_remote: Productivity MCP https://mcp.algolia.com/mcp, Streamable HTTP, OAuth (must be enabled in dashboard first)
mcp.docs_mcp: DevEx MCP https://mcp.algolia.com/1/snippets/mcp (no auth, version-accurate client snippets from OpenAPI) + DocSearch MCP
mcp.other: Public MCP for unauthenticated agent-facing search over curated indices
mcp.one_click: Cursor deeplinks for Productivity + DevEx; claude mcp add; ChatGPT/Claude connector instructions; Gemini CLI; Claude Code plugin marketplace algolia/skills

docs_for_agents.llms_txt: https://www.algolia.com/llms.txt (points agents to build-with-ai.md) and https://www.algolia.com/doc/llms.txt (per-section _llms/*.txt)
docs_for_agents.openapi: yes - /specs/search.yml, recommend.yml, ingestion.yml, agent-studio.yml etc. listed in doc llms.txt
docs_for_agents.use_with_ai_page: https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/get-started/build-with-ai.md - contains an explicit 'Agent setup' block telling agents exactly which commands to run and which to skip
docs_for_agents.agents_md_or_rules: algolia/skills repo (algolia-cli, quickstart, crawler, data-modeling, audit... with evals)

time_to_first_call_notes: Agent runs signup/login; human completes browser signup + consent; CLI auto-provisions keys.
agent_friendliness_justification: CLI-driven signup + OAuth login with automatic key provisioning, hosted OAuth MCP with DCR, unauthenticated DevEx MCP, and agent-addressed setup instructions in llms.txt.
best_practice: llms.txt line 'Fetch and follow the instructions at build-with-ai.md' leading to an agent-only, validated setup script that tells the agent what NOT to run.
biggest_gap: Productivity MCP must be switched on in the dashboard by a human before OAuth works; signup still a browser form.
